# fleetdm_software_patch_deadline_settings (Resource)

Manages a fleet's software patch deadline settings: the weekdays and host-local time when patch deadlines fall.

Requires Fleet Premium and Fleet >= 4.95.

~> Every fleet always has patch deadline settings. Destroying this resource resets them to Fleet's default (`tuesday` at `17:00`) rather than removing them. If the fleet itself has already been deleted, destroy succeeds without doing anything.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Set when patch deadlines fall for a fleet's hosts (host-local time)
resource "fleetdm_fleet" "workstations" {
  name = "Workstations"
}

resource "fleetdm_software_patch_deadline_settings" "workstations" {
  fleet_id = fleetdm_fleet.workstations.id
  days     = ["monday", "thursday"]
  time     = "09:00"
}

# Hosts that are not assigned to a fleet use fleet_id 0
resource "fleetdm_software_patch_deadline_settings" "unassigned" {
  fleet_id = 0
  days     = ["wednesday"]
  time     = "18:30"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `days` (Set of String) The weekdays when patch deadlines fall, as lowercase names: `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday` or `sunday`. At least one day is required.
- `fleet_id` (Number) The ID of the fleet (team) the settings apply to. Use `0` for hosts that are not assigned to a fleet (Unassigned). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `time` (String) The host-local time when patch deadlines fall, in 24-hour `HH:MM` format with a two-digit hour (for example `"09:00"` or `"17:30"`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The fleet ID as a string (`"0"` for Unassigned).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a fleet's patch deadline settings using the fleet ID
terraform import fleetdm_software_patch_deadline_settings.workstations 3

# Hosts that are not assigned to a fleet use fleet ID 0
terraform import fleetdm_software_patch_deadline_settings.unassigned 0
```
